To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
deep bidirectional LSTMs with layer-wise pretraining outperform deep feed-forward neural networks and that they have comparable training time per iteration.
deep bidirectional LSTM RNN based acoustic models outperform FFNN based models and that a layer-wise pretraining scheme is helpful for deep bidirectional LSTMs.

(a) bidirectional LSTMs are a very good choice for acoustic modeling; (b) deep LSTMs are better than shallow LSTMs; (c) pretraining with layer-wise construction is beneficial for deep LSTMS; (d) dropout is beneficial for deep bidirectional LSTMS; and (e) the training calculation time for LSTMs is higher than for FFNNs.
